grounding.from: Showers are likely Tuesday night, mainly after midnight, with about a 60% chance per the NWS

value.answer: Tomorrow in Denver looks mostly sunny and dry, high around 69 to 73°F, with a low around 46 to 47°F overnight. Showers are likely after midnight Tuesday night, about a 60% chance, and it turns cooler on Wednesday. That's from forecasts issued Oct 10 and 11, so it may have shifted a little.
